units.source_text: 出家人和姑娘究竟是怎么啦？

en.t: What on earth was going on between the monk and the girl?

units.source_text: 他们显然不是父女关系。

en.t: They were clearly not father and daughter.

units.source_text: 因此，如果能用一根线把他们联结起来的话，这就将成为一篇短篇小说。

en.t: So if one could connect them with a single thread, it would become a short story.

units.source_text: 这么想着，刚过了一个月的某一天，在九段举办的秋季招魂节上，我第二次见到了出家人。

en.t: Thinking this, a little over a month later, one day at the autumn Shokon Festival held in Kudan, I saw the monk for the second time.

units.source_text: 那时候正好是刚刚流行《八木小调》，他是在招魂节期间被八木小调戏棚的主人邀请来的吧。

en.t: At that time Yagi Kouta had just come into fashion, and he had probably been invited during the festival by the owner of the Yagi Kouta show tent.

units.source_text: 提供节日节目的戏棚为了招揽观众，不时把戏棚前的帷幕拉开，让过往行人可以瞧瞧里面的演技，还能从外面瞧见后台的一部分。

en.t: To draw in spectators, the show tents offering festival entertainments would occasionally pull open the curtain at the front, letting passersby glimpse the performances inside and even see part of the backstage from outside.

units.source_text: 行人可以从戏棚的入口仰望后台。

en.t: Passersby could look up at the backstage area from the entrance of the show tent.

units.source_text: 群众的热烈氛围，使跳舞的姑娘们高兴得有点发疯似的，喧闹异常。

en.t: The fervor of the crowd made the dancing girls so delighted they seemed almost frantic, and the noise was extraordinary.

units.source_text: 姑娘们将出家人抱住，同他撒娇、恶作剧、逗乐，他整个人被姑娘们包围。

en.t: The girls hugged the monk, clung to him playfully, teased him, and made jokes, surrounding him completely.

units.source_text: 姑娘们时而把手巾绑在他脖子上，时而又缠在他头上。

en.t: At times the girls tied a towel around his neck, and at other times they wrapped it around his head.

units.source_text: 他敲着大鼓，脚步摇摇晃晃地追赶着姑娘们。

en.t: He beat the big drum and staggered after the girls on unsteady feet.

units.source_text: 他时而坐下，时而站起，手足仿佛不是自己的东西似的。

en.t: He sat down and stood up by turns, as if his hands and feet did not belong to him.
